subject: ZenWorks SIG questionnaire — evidence collection & mapping playbook
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@zenworks.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ZenWorks SIG questionnaire — initial scope and timelines

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the SIG questionnaire we covered on the call earlier today (we consolidated a few asks). Our procurement and security teams want: a control mapping to the questionnaire, evidence artifacts where available, and a suggested intake timeline so we can align internal reviewers.

Key asks:
- Mapping for all SIG controls that are in scope for our deployment (we plan multi-tenant hosted API initially)
- Evidence (screenshots, config extracts, SOC 2 test reports where permissible) for all in-scope controls
- A single-point owner at Redwood who can coordinate artifact collection and legal review.

Can you confirm estimated delivery cadence? We are aiming to have an internal review complete by May 10th.

Attaching: ZenWorks-SIG-v2.xlsx (the questionnaire)

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Program Manager, ZenWorks
laura.chen@zenworks.com
---
Attachment: ZenWorks-SIG-v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWorks SIG questionnaire — initial scope and timelines

Hi Laura,

Appreciate the clear asks. I'll lead the intake and Kimberly will be the procurement contact for contract items. High-level plan below — I can send a formal playbook (with owners, artifact templates, and a shared Drive) by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed intake playbook (summary):
- Week 1 (Apr 20–26): Control mapping deliverable (we'll map Redwood controls to the SIG rows and indicate available evidence)
- Week 2 (Apr 27–May 3): Artifact collection — we will drop PDFs and screenshots into a shared folder, and flag items that need redaction/legal review
- Week 3 (May 4–10): Internal review window for ZenWorks; we will respond to follow-up clarifications and provide SOC 2 report excerpts under NDA

Immediate clarifying questions:
1) Does the scope include the Dedicated and Private offering or only Hosted API for initial review?
2) Any specific proof formats you prefer (S3 link, Drive folder, or consolidated PDF bundle)?

I'll attach a first-pass control map for the Hosted API footprint so you can see the mapping format.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachment: redwood-soc2-control-map.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zenworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@zenworks.com>, ZenWorks Procurement <procurement@zenworks.com>
Date: 2029-04-22T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWorks SIG questionnaire — initial scope and timelines

Thanks Markus — this looks good. To clarify scope: for now please map Hosted API and Dedicated (we will trigger Private later if needed).

Preferred proof delivery: Drive folder is easiest for reviewers, but procurement will want a consolidated packet for legal. If you can provide both (artifact folder + a single manifest PDF), that would be ideal.

Also: procurement asked whether you can share (under NDA) the most recent SOC 2 Type II summary and test results that correspond to the control areas called out in the SIG. Procurement will circulate a DocuSign NDA in parallel.

Procurement contact Evan is CC'd — Evan, please confirm DocuSign contact if needed.

Best,
Laura

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZenWorks SIG questionnaire — artifact manifest and exceptions

Hi all,

Following up with a working manifest and notes on a few controls that require special handling. I uploaded the initial artifact bundle to the Drive link below and attached a one-page manifest for your intake team.

Quick notes / exceptions:
- Control A.4.2 (Key management): we can provide KMS configuration screenshots and key rotation logs, but the raw KMS audit trails are sensitive. We propose redacted extracts (timestamp + operation + key-id prefix).
- Control C.9.1 (Third-party reviews): Redwood uses a third-party penetration test provider. We can provide the executive summary and remediation attestation; full pentest reports require a controlled access process — we can arrange a secured download link if needed.
- Control E.2.3 (Change management): we will provide ticket workflow screenshots and a sample change approval ticket with PII redacted.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZ-zenworks-sig-evidence

Action items for Redwood:
- Deliver updated control map (row-level status: mapped / evidence ready / awaiting legal) by Apr 27
- Prepare consolidated manifest PDF for procurement
- Coordinate NDA exchange so SOC 2 artifacts can be shared securely

Attached: SIG_artifact_manifest_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SIG_artifact_manifest_v1.pdf (pdf)

Laura — Evan — team,

Thanks for the quick clarifications. Attached is the Redwood SIG playbook (short) and the control map updated for Hosted + Dedicated scope. Below is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep both sides aligned. If this looks good please reply with a one-line sign-off and we will begin artifact drops tomorrow.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Apr 30: Redwood shares Drive manifest, control map, and consolidated manifest PDF (done)
- May 1–3: Procurement executes NDA (DocuSign link below) so SOC 2 excerpts can be shared
- May 4–8: Artifact completion window — Redwood to populate folder with PDFs/screenshots/exec summaries
- May 9–10: ZenWorks internal review; submit clarifying questions to redwood-sig@redwoodinference.com

DocuSign NDA: https://app.docuSign.com/ZenWorks/Agreement12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aZ-zenworks-sig-evidence

Attachments: redwood-sig-playbook-v1.docx, redwood-soc2-control-map.xlsx

If we don't hear back by EOD May 1 we'll assume the MAP is acceptable and proceed with the artifact drop on May 2.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
